verses.original: יְהוָ֛ה וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹ֥ר אֲלֵהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’a·hă·rōn lê·mōr ’ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: The LORD spoke again to Moses . . . and Aaron telling them

verses.original: דַּבְּר֛וּ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר זֹ֤את מִכָּל־ הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ הַֽחַיָּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֹּאכְל֔וּ
verses.transliteration: dab·bə·rū ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr zōṯ mik·kāl hab·bə·hê·māh ’ă·šer ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ ha·ḥay·yāh ’ă·šer tō·ḵə·lū
verses.literal: Say to the Israelites . . . - - Of all the beasts - of the earth [these ones] - you may eat

verses.original: תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃ כֹּ֣ל׀ בַּבְּהֵמָ֑ה אֹתָ֖הּ שֶׁ֙סַע֙ פְּרָסֹ֔ת מַפְרֶ֣סֶת פַּרְסָ֗ה וְשֹׁסַ֤עַת מַעֲלַ֥ת גֵּרָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: tō·ḵê·lū kōl bab·bə·hê·māh ’ō·ṯāh še·sa‘ pə·rā·sōṯ map̄·re·seṯ par·sāh wə·šō·sa·‘aṯ ma·‘ă·laṯ gê·rāh
verses.literal: You may eat any animal - [that has] a split . . . - hoof completely divided and that chews the cud

verses.original: אַ֤ךְ אֶת־ מִֽמַּעֲלֵי֙ הַגֵּרָ֔ה וּמִמַּפְרִיסֵ֖י הַפַּרְסָ֑ה אֶֽת־ לֹ֣א תֹֽאכְל֔וּ זֶה֙ הַ֠גָּמָל כִּֽי־ ה֗וּא מַעֲלֵ֨ה גֵרָ֜ה אֵינֶ֣נּוּ מַפְרִ֔יס וּפַרְסָה֙ ה֖וּא טָמֵ֥א לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ ’eṯ- mim·ma·‘ă·lê hag·gê·rāh ū·mim·map̄·rî·sê hap·par·sāh ’eṯ- lō ṯō·ḵə·lū zeh hag·gā·māl kî- hū ma·‘ă·lêh ḡê·rāh ’ê·nen·nū map̄·rîs ū·p̄ar·sāh hū ṭā·mê lā·ḵem
verses.literal: But of those that [only] chew the cud or [only] have a divided hoof - you are not to eat the following The camel though it chews the cud does not have a divided hoof it is unclean for you

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַשָּׁפָ֗ן כִּֽי־ ה֔וּא מַעֲלֵ֤ה גֵרָה֙ לֹ֣א יַפְרִ֑יס וּפַרְסָ֖ה ה֖וּא טָמֵ֥א לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- haš·šā·p̄ān kî- hū ma·‘ă·lêh ḡê·rāh lō yap̄·rîs ū·p̄ar·sāh hū ṭā·mê lā·ḵem
verses.literal: - The rock badger though it chews the cud does not have a divided hoof it is unclean for you

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הָאַרְנֶ֗בֶת כִּֽי־ הִ֔וא מַעֲלַ֤ת גֵּרָה֙ לֹ֣א הִפְרִ֑יסָה וּפַרְסָ֖ה הִ֖וא טְמֵאָ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hā·’ar·ne·ḇeṯ kî- hî ma·‘ă·laṯ gê·rāh lō hip̄·rî·sāh ū·p̄ar·sāh hî ṭə·mê·’āh lā·ḵem
verses.literal: - The rabbit though it chews the cud does not have a divided hoof it is unclean for you

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַ֠חֲזִיר כִּֽי־ ה֗וּא שֶׁ֙סַע֙ פַּרְסָ֜ה מַפְרִ֨יס וְשֹׁסַ֥ע פַּרְסָ֔ה וְה֖וּא לֹֽא־ יִגָּ֑ר גֵּרָ֣ה ה֖וּא טָמֵ֥א לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥă·zîr kî- hū še·sa‘ par·sāh map̄·rîs wə·šō·sa‘ par·sāh wə·hū lō- yig·gār gê·rāh hū ṭā·mê lā·ḵem
verses.literal: And the pig though it [has] a split hoof completely divided . . . - - does not chew the cud it [is] unclean for you

verses.original: לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֔לוּ מִבְּשָׂרָם֙ תִגָּ֑עוּ וּבְנִבְלָתָ֖ם לֹ֣א הֵ֖ם טְמֵאִ֥ים לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lō ṯō·ḵê·lū mib·bə·śā·rām ṯig·gā·‘ū ū·ḇə·niḇ·lā·ṯām lō hêm ṭə·mê·’îm lā·ḵem
verses.literal: vvv You must not eat their meat or touch their carcasses . . . they are unclean for you

verses.original: אֶת־ מִכֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּמָּ֑יִם בַּיַּמִּ֛ים וּבַנְּחָלִ֖ים אֹתָ֥ם תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃ תֹּֽאכְל֔וּ זֶה֙ כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ לוֹ֩ סְנַפִּ֨יר וְקַשְׂקֶ֜שֶׂת בַּמַּ֗יִם
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- mik·kōl ’ă·šer bam·mā·yim bay·yam·mîm ū·ḇan·nə·ḥā·lîm ’ō·ṯām tō·ḵê·lū tō·ḵə·lū zeh kōl ’ă·šer- lōw sə·nap·pîr wə·qaś·qe·śeṯ bam·ma·yim
verses.literal: - Of all [the creatures] that [live] in the water whether in the seas or in the streams - - you may eat - anything with fins and scales . . .

verses.original: הֵ֖ם מִכֹּל֙ שֶׁ֣רֶץ הַחַיָּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּמָּ֑יִם נֶ֥פֶשׁ הַמַּ֔יִם שֶׁ֥קֶץ לָכֶֽם׃ וְכֹל֩ בַּיַּמִּים֙ וּבַנְּחָלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֵֽין־ ל֜וֹ סְנַפִּ֣יר וְקַשְׂקֶ֗שֶׂת וּמִכֹּ֛ל
verses.transliteration: hêm mik·kōl še·reṣ ha·ḥay·yāh ’ă·šer bam·mā·yim ne·p̄eš ham·ma·yim še·qeṣ lā·ḵem wə·ḵōl bay·yam·mîm ū·ḇan·nə·ḥā·lîm ’ă·šer ’ên- lōw sə·nap·pîr wə·qaś·qe·śeṯ ū·mik·kōl
verses.literal: But the following among all the teeming life - - and creatures in the water are detestable to you everything in the seas or streams that does not have fins and scales . . .

verses.original: יִהְי֣וּ וְשֶׁ֖קֶץ לָכֶ֑ם לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֔לוּ וְאֶת־ מִבְּשָׂרָם֙ תְּשַׁקֵּֽצוּ׃ נִבְלָתָ֖ם
verses.transliteration: yih·yū wə·še·qeṣ lā·ḵem lō ṯō·ḵê·lū wə·’eṯ- mib·bə·śā·rām tə·šaq·qê·ṣū niḇ·lā·ṯām
verses.literal: They shall be an abomination to you you must not eat - their meat and you must detest their carcasses

verses.original: כֹּ֣ל בַּמָּ֑יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵֽין־ ל֛וֹ סְנַפִּ֥יר וְקַשְׂקֶ֖שֶׂת שֶׁ֥קֶץ ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kōl bam·mā·yim ’ă·šer ’ên- lōw sə·nap·pîr wə·qaś·qe·śeṯ še·qeṣ hū lā·ḵem
verses.literal: Everything in the water that does not have fins and scales shall be detestable . . . to you

verses.original: וְאֶת־ תְּשַׁקְּצ֣וּ מִן־ אֵ֙לֶּה֙ הָע֔וֹף לֹ֥א יֵאָכְל֖וּ הֵ֑ם אֶת־ שֶׁ֣קֶץ הַנֶּ֙שֶׁר֙ וְאֶת־ הַפֶּ֔רֶס וְאֵ֖ת הָעָזְנִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- tə·šaq·qə·ṣū min- ’êl·leh hā·‘ō·wp̄ lō yê·’ā·ḵə·lū hêm ’eṯ- še·qeṣ han·ne·šer wə·’eṯ- hap·pe·res wə·’êṯ hā·‘ā·zə·nî·yāh
verses.literal: Additionally you are to detest . . . the following birds and they must not be eaten because they - are detestable the eagle - the bearded vulture - the black vulture

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַ֨דָּאָ֔ה וְאֶת־ לְמִינָֽהּ׃ הָאַיָּ֖ה
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- had·dā·’āh wə·’eṯ- lə·mî·nāh hā·’ay·yāh
verses.literal: - the kite - any kind of falcon

verses.original: אֵ֥ת כָּל־ לְמִינֽוֹ׃ עֹרֵ֖ב
verses.transliteration: ’êṯ kāl- lə·mî·nōw ‘ō·rêḇ
verses.literal: - any kind of raven

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ בַּ֣ת הַֽיַּעֲנָ֔ה וְאֶת־ הַתַּחְמָ֖ס וְאֶת־ הַשָּׁ֑חַף וְאֶת־ לְמִינֵֽהוּ׃ הַנֵּ֖ץ
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ baṯ hay·ya·‘ă·nāh wə·’eṯ- hat·taḥ·mās wə·’eṯ- haš·šā·ḥap̄ wə·’eṯ- lə·mî·nê·hū han·nêṣ
verses.literal: - vvv the ostrich - the screech owl - the gull - any kind of hawk

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַכּ֥וֹס וְאֶת־ הַשָּׁלָ֖ךְ וְאֶת־ הַיַּנְשֽׁוּף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hak·kō·ws wə·’eṯ- haš·šā·lāḵ wə·’eṯ- hay·yan·šūp̄
verses.literal: - the little owl - the cormorant - the great owl

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַתִּנְשֶׁ֥מֶת וְאֶת־ הַקָּאָ֖ת וְאֶת־ הָרָחָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hat·tin·še·meṯ wə·’eṯ- haq·qā·’āṯ wə·’eṯ- hā·rā·ḥām
verses.literal: - the white owl - the desert owl - the osprey

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ הַחֲסִידָ֔ה לְמִינָ֑הּ וְאֶת־ הָאֲנָפָ֖ה הַדּוּכִיפַ֖ת וְאֶת־ הָעֲטַלֵּֽף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ ha·ḥă·sî·ḏāh lə·mî·nāh wə·’eṯ- hā·’ă·nā·p̄āh had·dū·ḵî·p̄aṯ wə·’eṯ- hā·‘ă·ṭal·lêp̄
verses.literal: - the stork any kind - of heron the hoopoe and the bat

verses.original: כֹּ֚ל הָע֔וֹף שֶׁ֣רֶץ הַהֹלֵ֖ךְ עַל־ אַרְבַּ֑ע שֶׁ֥קֶץ ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: kōl hā·‘ō·wp̄ še·reṣ ha·hō·lêḵ ‘al- ’ar·ba‘ še·qeṣ hū lā·ḵem
verses.literal: All flying insects that walk on [all] fours are detestable . . . to you

verses.original: אַ֤ךְ אֶת־ תֹּֽאכְל֔וּ זֶה֙ מִכֹּל֙ הָע֔וֹף שֶׁ֣רֶץ הַהֹלֵ֖ךְ עַל־ אַרְבַּ֑ע אֲשֶׁר־ לֹא כְרָעַ֙יִם֙ מִמַּ֣עַל לְרַגְלָ֔יו לְנַתֵּ֥ר בָּהֵ֖ן עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ ’eṯ- tō·ḵə·lū zeh mik·kōl hā·‘ō·wp̄ še·reṣ ha·hō·lêḵ ‘al- ’ar·ba‘ ’ă·šer- lō ḵə·rā·‘a·yim mim·ma·‘al lə·raḡ·lāw lə·nat·têr bā·hên ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: However - you may eat the following kinds of flying insects that walk on all fours those - having jointed legs above their feet for hopping . . . on the ground

verses.original: אֶת־ אֵ֤לֶּה מֵהֶם֙ תֹּאכֵ֔לוּ אֶת־ לְמִינ֔וֹ וְאֶת־ הָֽאַרְבֶּ֣ה הַסָּלְעָ֖ם לְמִינֵ֑הוּ וְאֶת־ הַחַרְגֹּ֣ל לְמִינֵ֔הוּ וְאֶת־ הֶחָגָ֖ב לְמִינֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- ’êl·leh mê·hem tō·ḵê·lū ’eṯ- lə·mî·nōw wə·’eṯ- hā·’ar·beh has·sā·lə·‘ām lə·mî·nê·hū wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥar·gōl lə·mî·nê·hū wə·’eṯ- he·ḥā·ḡāḇ lə·mî·nê·hū
verses.literal: - Of these - you may eat - any kind - of locust katydid . . . - cricket . . . - or grasshopper . . .

verses.original: וְכֹל֙ הָע֔וֹף שֶׁ֣רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֖וֹ אַרְבַּ֣ע רַגְלָ֑יִם שֶׁ֥קֶץ ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl hā·‘ō·wp̄ še·reṣ ’ă·šer- lōw ’ar·ba‘ raḡ·lā·yim še·qeṣ hū lā·ḵem
verses.literal: All [other] flying insects that have four legs are detestable . . . to you

verses.original: וּלְאֵ֖לֶּה תִּטַּמָּ֑אוּ כָּל־ הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בְּנִבְלָתָ֖ם יִטְמָ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·’êl·leh tiṭ·ṭam·mā·’ū kāl- han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bə·niḇ·lā·ṯām yiṭ·mā ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: These [creatures] will make you unclean Whoever touches their carcasses will be unclean until evening

verses.original: וְכָל־ הַנֹּשֵׂ֖א מִנִּבְלָתָ֑ם יְכַבֵּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl han·nō·śê min·niḇ·lā·ṯām yə·ḵab·bês bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: and whoever picks up one of their carcasses must wash his clothes and he will be unclean until evening

verses.original: לְֽכָל־ הַבְּהֵמָ֡ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִוא֩ וְשֶׁ֣סַע׀ פַּרְסָ֜ה אֵינֶ֣נָּה מַפְרֶ֨סֶת שֹׁסַ֗עַת אֵינֶ֣נָּה מַעֲלָ֔ה וְגֵרָה֙ טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖ם לָכֶ֑ם כָּל־ הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּהֶ֖ם יִטְמָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵāl hab·bə·hê·māh ’ă·šer hî wə·še·sa‘ par·sāh ’ê·nen·nāh map̄·re·seṯ šō·sa·‘aṯ ’ê·nen·nāh ma·‘ă·lāh wə·ḡê·rāh ṭə·mê·’îm hêm lā·ḵem kāl- han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bā·hem yiṭ·mā
verses.literal: Every animal with . . . vvv hooves not completely divided . . . or that does not chew the cud is unclean . . . for you Whoever touches any of them will be unclean

verses.original: וְכֹ֣ל׀ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ עַל־ אַרְבַּ֔ע הַֽחַיָּה֙ הַהֹלֶ֣כֶת עַל־ כַּפָּ֗יו בְּכָל־ טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖ם לָכֶ֑ם כָּל־ הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בְּנִבְלָתָ֖ם יִטְמָ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl hō·w·lêḵ ‘al- ’ar·ba‘ ha·ḥay·yāh ha·hō·le·ḵeṯ ‘al- kap·pāw bə·ḵāl ṭə·mê·’îm hêm lā·ḵem kāl- han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bə·niḇ·lā·ṯām yiṭ·mā ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: All the four-footed . . . . . . animals that walk on their paws . . . are unclean . . . for you whoever touches their carcasses will be unclean until evening

verses.original: וְהַנֹּשֵׂא֙ אֶת־ נִבְלָתָ֔ם יְכַבֵּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָמֵ֣א עַד־ הָעָ֑רֶב הֵ֖מָּה טְמֵאִ֥ים לָכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·han·nō·śê ’eṯ- niḇ·lā·ṯām yə·ḵab·bês bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ hêm·māh ṭə·mê·’îm lā·ḵem
verses.literal: and anyone who picks up - a carcass must wash his clothes and he will be unclean until evening They are unclean for you

verses.original: וְזֶ֤ה בַּשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵ֣ץ עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ הַטָּמֵ֔א לָכֶם֙ הַחֹ֥לֶד וְהָעַכְבָּ֖ר לְמִינֵֽהוּ׃ וְהַצָּ֥ב
verses.transliteration: wə·zeh baš·še·reṣ haš·šō·rêṣ ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ haṭ·ṭā·mê lā·ḵem ha·ḥō·leḏ wə·hā·‘aḵ·bār lə·mî·nê·hū wə·haṣ·ṣāḇ
verses.literal: The following creatures that move along the ground are unclean for you the mole the mouse any kind of great lizard

verses.original: וְהָאֲנָקָ֥ה וְהַכֹּ֖חַ וְהַלְּטָאָ֑ה וְהַחֹ֖מֶט וְהַתִּנְשָֽׁמֶת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ă·nā·qāh wə·hak·kō·aḥ wə·hal·lə·ṭā·’āh wə·ha·ḥō·meṭ wə·hat·tin·šā·meṯ
verses.literal: the gecko the monitor lizard the common lizard the skink and the chameleon

verses.original: אֵ֛לֶּה הַטְּמֵאִ֥ים לָכֶ֖ם בְּכָל־ הַשָּׁ֑רֶץ כָּל־ הַנֹּגֵ֧עַ בָּהֶ֛ם בְּמֹתָ֖ם יִטְמָ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh haṭ·ṭə·mê·’îm lā·ḵem bə·ḵāl haš·šā·reṣ kāl- han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bā·hem bə·mō·ṯām yiṭ·mā ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: These [animals] are unclean for you among all the crawling creatures Whoever touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until evening

verses.original: וְכֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ בְּמֹתָ֜ם יִפֹּל־ עָלָיו֩ מֵהֶ֨ם׀ יִטְמָ֗א מִכָּל־ כְּלִי־ עֵץ֙ א֣וֹ בֶ֤גֶד אוֹ־ עוֹר֙ א֣וֹ שָׂ֔ק כָּל־ כְּלִ֕י אֲשֶׁר־ יֵעָשֶׂ֥ה מְלָאכָ֖ה בָּהֶ֑ם בַּמַּ֧יִם יוּבָ֛א וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעֶ֖רֶב וְטָהֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- bə·mō·ṯām yip·pōl- ‘ā·lāw mê·hem yiṭ·mā mik·kāl kə·lî- ‘êṣ ’ōw ḇe·ḡeḏ ’ōw- ‘ō·wr ’ōw śāq kāl- kə·lî ’ă·šer- yê·‘ā·śeh mə·lā·ḵāh bā·hem bam·ma·yim yū·ḇā wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘e·reḇ wə·ṭā·hêr
verses.literal: When one of them dies and falls on something [that article] becomes unclean any article of wood . . . clothing . . . leather . . . sackcloth or any implement - used for work must be rinsed with water . . . and will remain unclean until evening then it will be clean

verses.original: מֵהֶ֖ם יִפֹּ֥ל אֶל־ תּוֹכ֑וֹ וְכָל־ חֶ֔רֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר־ כְּלִי־ כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּתוֹכ֛וֹ יִטְמָ֖א וְאֹת֥וֹ תִשְׁבֹּֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: mê·hem yip·pōl ’el- tō·w·ḵōw wə·ḵāl ḥe·reś ’ă·šer- kə·lî- kōl ’ă·šer bə·ṯō·w·ḵōw yiṭ·mā wə·’ō·ṯōw ṯiš·bō·rū
verses.literal: If any of them falls into . . . a clay - pot everything - in it will be unclean - you must break [the pot]

verses.original: מִכָּל־ יֵאָכֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָאֹ֜כֶל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָב֥וֹא עָלָ֛יו מַ֖יִם יִטְמָ֑א וְכָל־ יִשָּׁתֶ֔ה מַשְׁקֶה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּכָל־ כְּלִ֖י יִטְמָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: mik·kāl yê·’ā·ḵêl ’ă·šer hā·’ō·ḵel ’ă·šer yā·ḇō·w ‘ā·lāw ma·yim yiṭ·mā wə·ḵāl yiš·šā·ṯeh maš·qeh ’ă·šer bə·ḵāl kə·lî yiṭ·mā
verses.literal: Any vvv vvv food - coming into contact with water [from that pot] will be unclean and any drink . . . - in such a container will be unclean

verses.original: וְ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁר־ מִנִּבְלָתָ֥ם׀ יִפֹּ֨ל עָלָיו֮ יִטְמָא֒ תַּנּ֧וּר וְכִירַ֛יִם יֻתָּ֖ץ הֵ֑ם טְמֵאִ֣ים יִהְי֥וּ וּטְמֵאִ֖ים לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- min·niḇ·lā·ṯām yip·pōl ‘ā·lāw yiṭ·mā tan·nūr wə·ḵî·ra·yim yut·tāṣ hêm ṭə·mê·’îm yih·yū ū·ṭə·mê·’îm lā·ḵem
verses.literal: Anything upon which one of their carcasses falls - will be unclean If it is an oven or cooking pot it must be smashed it is unclean and will remain unclean for you

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ מַעְיָ֥ן וּב֛וֹר מִקְוֵה־ מַ֖יִם יִהְיֶ֣ה טָה֑וֹר וְנֹגֵ֥עַ בְּנִבְלָתָ֖ם יִטְמָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ ma‘·yān ū·ḇō·wr miq·wêh- ma·yim yih·yeh ṭā·hō·wr wə·nō·ḡê·a‘ bə·niḇ·lā·ṯām yiṭ·mā
verses.literal: Nevertheless a spring or cistern containing water will remain clean but one who touches a carcass in it will be unclean

verses.original: וְכִ֤י מִנִּבְלָתָ֔ם יִפֹּל֙ עַל־ כָּל־ זֶ֥רַע זֵר֖וּעַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִזָּרֵ֑עַ הֽוּא׃ טָה֖וֹר
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî min·niḇ·lā·ṯām yip·pōl ‘al- kāl- ze·ra‘ zê·rū·a‘ ’ă·šer yiz·zā·rê·a‘ hū ṭā·hō·wr
verses.literal: If a carcass falls on any seed for sowing - - [the seed] is clean

verses.original: וְכִ֤י מַ֙יִם֙ יֻתַּן־ עַל־ זֶ֔רַע מִנִּבְלָתָ֖ם וְנָפַ֥ל עָלָ֑יו ה֖וּא טָמֵ֥א לָכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî ma·yim yut·tan- ‘al- ze·ra‘ min·niḇ·lā·ṯām wə·nā·p̄al ‘ā·lāw hū ṭā·mê lā·ḵem
verses.literal: but if water has been put on the seed and a carcass falls on it it is unclean for you

verses.original: וְכִ֤י מִן־ הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ הִ֥יא לָכֶ֖ם לְאָכְלָ֑ה יָמוּת֙ הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בְּנִבְלָתָ֖הּ יִטְמָ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî min- hab·bə·hê·māh ’ă·šer- hî lā·ḵem lə·’āḵ·lāh yā·mūṯ han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bə·niḇ·lā·ṯāh yiṭ·mā ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: If an animal that . . . you may eat dies anyone who touches the carcass will be unclean until evening

verses.original: וְהָֽאֹכֵל֙ מִנִּבְלָתָ֔הּ יְכַבֵּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָמֵ֣א עַד־ הָעָ֑רֶב וְהַנֹּשֵׂא֙ אֶת־ נִבְלָתָ֔הּ יְכַבֵּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ō·ḵêl min·niḇ·lā·ṯāh yə·ḵab·bês bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ wə·han·nō·śê ’eṯ- niḇ·lā·ṯāh yə·ḵab·bês bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: Whoever eats from the carcass must wash his clothes and will be unclean until evening and anyone who picks up - the carcass must wash his clothes and will be unclean until evening

verses.original: וְכָל־ הַשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵ֣ץ עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ שֶׁ֥קֶץ ה֖וּא לֹ֥א יֵאָכֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl haš·še·reṣ haš·šō·rêṣ ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ še·qeṣ hū lō yê·’ā·ḵêl
verses.literal: Every creature that moves along the ground is detestable it must not be eaten

verses.original: לֹ֥א תֹאכְל֖וּם הַשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵ֣ץ עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ כֹּל֩ הוֹלֵ֨ךְ עַל־ גָּח֜וֹן וְכֹ֣ל׀ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ עַל־ אַרְבַּ֗ע עַ֚ד כָּל־ מַרְבֵּ֣ה רַגְלַ֔יִם לְכָל־ כִּי־ הֵֽם׃ שֶׁ֥קֶץ
verses.transliteration: lō ṯō·ḵə·lūm haš·še·reṣ haš·šō·rêṣ ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ kōl hō·w·lêḵ ‘al- gå̄·ḥōn wə·ḵōl hō·w·lêḵ ‘al- ’ar·ba‘ ‘aḏ kāl- mar·bêh raḡ·la·yim lə·ḵāl kî- hêm še·qeṣ
verses.literal: Do not eat any creature that moves along the ground whether it crawls on its belly or walks on four or . . . more feet . . . for such [creatures] are detestable

verses.original: אַל־ תְּשַׁקְּצוּ֙ אֶת־ נַפְשֹׁ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכָל־ הַשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵ֑ץ וְלֹ֤א תִֽטַּמְּאוּ֙ בָּהֶ֔ם וְנִטְמֵתֶ֖ם בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tə·šaq·qə·ṣū ’eṯ- nap̄·šō·ṯê·ḵem bə·ḵāl haš·še·reṣ haš·šō·rêṣ wə·lō ṯiṭ·ṭam·mə·’ū bā·hem wə·niṭ·mê·ṯem bām
verses.literal: Do not defile - yourselves by any crawling creature . . . do not become unclean or defiled by them

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָה֮ אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֒ וְהִתְקַדִּשְׁתֶּם֙ וִהְיִיתֶ֣ם קְדֹשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י אָ֑נִי קָד֖וֹשׁ וְלֹ֤א תְטַמְּאוּ֙ אֶת־ נַפְשֹׁ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכָל־ הַשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הָרֹמֵ֥שׂ עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem wə·hiṯ·qad·diš·tem wih·yî·ṯem qə·ḏō·šîm kî ’ā·nî qā·ḏō·wōš wə·lō ṯə·ṭam·mə·’ū ’eṯ- nap̄·šō·ṯê·ḵem bə·ḵāl haš·še·reṣ hā·rō·mêś ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: For I am the LORD your God consecrate yourselves, therefore and be holy because I am holy You must not defile - yourselves by any creature that crawls along the ground

verses.original: כִּ֣י׀ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה הַֽמַּעֲלֶ֤ה אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִהְיֹ֥ת לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִ֑ים וִהְיִיתֶ֣ם קְדֹשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י אָֽנִי׃ קָד֖וֹשׁ
verses.transliteration: kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ham·ma·‘ă·leh ’eṯ·ḵem mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim lih·yōṯ lā·ḵem lê·lō·hîm wih·yî·ṯem qə·ḏō·šîm kî ’ā·nî qā·ḏō·wōš
verses.literal: For I am the LORD who brought you up - out of the land of Egypt so that I would be your God therefore be holy because I am holy

verses.original: זֹ֣את תּוֹרַ֤ת הַבְּהֵמָה֙ וְהָע֔וֹף וְכֹל֙ הַֽחַיָּ֔ה נֶ֣פֶשׁ הָרֹמֶ֖שֶׂת בַּמָּ֑יִם וּלְכָל־ נֶ֖פֶשׁ הַשֹּׁרֶ֥צֶת עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ tō·w·raṯ hab·bə·hê·māh wə·hā·‘ō·wp̄ wə·ḵōl ha·ḥay·yāh ne·p̄eš hā·rō·me·śeṯ bam·mā·yim ū·lə·ḵāl- ne·p̄eš haš·šō·re·ṣeṯ ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: This is the law regarding animals birds all living creatures that move in the water and all creatures that crawl along the ground

verses.original: לְהַבְדִּ֕יל בֵּ֥ין הַטָּמֵ֖א הַטָּהֹ֑ר וּבֵ֤ין וּבֵ֣ין הַֽחַיָּה֙ הַֽנֶּאֱכֶ֔לֶת וּבֵין֙ הַֽחַיָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א תֵאָכֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: lə·haḇ·dîl bên haṭ·ṭā·mê haṭ·ṭā·hōr ū·ḇên ū·ḇên ha·ḥay·yāh han·ne·’ĕ·ḵe·leṯ ū·ḇên ha·ḥay·yāh ’ă·šer lō ṯê·’ā·ḵêl
verses.literal: You must distinguish between the unclean and the clean . . . between animals that may be eaten . . . and those that may not -
